ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis represents latitude, with 90°N on the left side, 90°S on the right side, 0° in the middle, and the nearby position of place Jia marked; the vertical direction marks sunrise times, including 3:00, 6:00, 9:00, 12:00, etc. The curve slopes from the lower left to the upper right, indicating that on the 120°E meridian, when latitude changes from north to south, the sunrise time gradually becomes later; the sunrise time near place Jia is approximately between 6:00 and 7:00. Reasoning: According to the diagram, near place Jia, if moving south along the 120°E meridian, the local sunrise time will become later. The later the local sunrise time, usually the shorter the day length, so the place whose "day length is slightly shorter than that of place Jia" should be located south of place Jia. If this place is still on the 120°E meridian, it will have sunrise later than place Jia; but the question requires the two places to welcome sunrise at the same time, so longitude must be changed to offset the sunrise delay of the southern place caused by latitude. The more eastward the longitude, the earlier the local time enters the sunrise moment, that is, the actual time corresponding to the same local-time event is earlier, so this place should be located east of place Jia. Combined judgment: this place is south and east of place Jia, so it is located in the southeast direction of place Jia.
